title: Nilikodisha jeepney nzima na nikapata usafiri wa kwenda nyumbani
label: Jeepney ya binafsi

text.In the Philippines, there is a vehicle c: Nchini Ufilipino kuna chombo cha usafiri kinachoitwa jeepney.
text.Usually, it is used as a way to get arou: Kwa kawaida hutumiwa kusafiri kama basi.
text.I was surprised to learn that you can us: Nilishangaa kujua kwamba unaweza kutumia jeepney badala ya teksi.
text.Usually, a jeepney leaves after it has p: Kwa kawaida, jeepney huondoka baada ya kuchukua idadi fulani ya abiria.
text.(I think the timing of leaving is quite: (Nadhani muda wa kuondoka hutofautiana sana kulingana na dereva.)
text.But if you tell the driver, \"I am in a: Lakini ukimwambia dereva, “Nina haraka kidogo sasa, tafadhali ondoka mara moja,” wakati mwingine huendesha kwa ajili yako tu kwa nauli inayokaribia kuwa sawa na ya teksi.
text.When I negotiated, the driver said, \"OK: Nilipokuwa nikijadiliana bei, dereva alisema, “Sawa. Ni takriban peso 300 kwa safari ya dakika 15, je, inakufaa?”
text.I said, \"That is fine,\" and got a ride: Nikasema, “Sawa,” kisha nikapanda jeepney kwenda nyumbani.
text.Since I had the chance, I also got to si: Kwa kuwa nilipata nafasi, nilikaa pia kwenye kiti cha dereva cha jeepney.
text.It is not a tank, but it is a rugged car: Si tanki, lakini ni gari imara kama gari la kijeshi, na madirisha yake pia ni madogo.
text.I rode it, impressed, thinking, \"How ca: Nilipanda nikiwa nimeshangazwa na kuwaza, “Wanawezaje kuendesha hili kwa usalama?”
